fusions.name: Branching Reach
fusions.desc: Grows a blade of coral out to a target up to 4 tiles away for 3 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grown From Bone
fusions.desc: Grows a fan of razor branches from your arm through a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, dealing 8 damage and leaving each enemy [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Staghorn Outcrop
fusions.desc: Grows a razor-edged outcrop that stands for 12 seconds and cuts an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, each cut with a 30% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield worth 3% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
